parole.significato: An Indo-Aryan language, the official language of the Republic of Maldives.
A handcrafted sailboat with a motor or lateen sails, resembling a dhow, that is used in the Maldives.
A subdenomination of the rufiyaa, 1/100 of its value.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Dhivehi ލާރި (lāri). Doublet of lari.

parole.significato: The official currency of the Maldives, equal to 100 laari.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Dhivehi ރުފިޔާ (rufiyā), ultimately borrowed from Sanskrit रूप्यक (rūpyaka, “a silver coin”), from रूप्य (rūpya, “wrought silver”). Doublet of rupee and rupiah.
